sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANASH RANJAN PATHAK  ORDER 04-04-2025 Heard Mr. A. Goyal, learned counsel for the petitioner.

The sole respondent filed a complaint case against the petitioner on 01.06.2023 under Section 200 CrPC for committing offence under Sections 498A/323 IPC before the learned CJM, Kamrup (M), Guwahati, being Complaint Case No. 234 C/2023.

Page No.# 2/2 The learned JMFC, Kamrup (M), Guwahati on 12.12.2024 took cognizance of the offence under Section 498A IPC against the petitioner in said Complaint Case No. 234 C/2023.

Hence, this application under Section 528 BNSS praying for quashing of the said Complaint Case No. 234C/2023 as well as the order of taking cognizance of the offence under Section 498A IPC against the petitioner in said Complaint Case No. 234 C/2023 passed by the learned JMFC, Kamrup (M), Guwahati.
Petitioner shall take steps for service of notice on the sole respondent by Registered post with A/D by tomorrow, providing her correct and proper address with requisite postal stamps.
The interim prayer of the petitioner shall be considered on the returnable date, after due service of notice on the sole respondent.
